items.title: Marketers’ Guide to Late BFCM Email
items.zh_title: 黑五网一后期邮件营销指南
items.zh_oneliner: 大促后半程的邮件还能再捞一波订单。
items.en_oneliner: Email in the second half of a big sale can still win another round of orders.

items.title: Amazon Brand Story Tips to Match Buyer Intent and Turn Browsers Into Buyers
items.zh_title: 亚马逊品牌故事怎么写才对买家胃口
items.zh_oneliner: 品牌故事出现在每个商品页，写偏了等于处处丢分，要贴合买家意图。
items.en_oneliner: Brand Stories appear on every product page, so an off-target story loses points everywhere; keep it matched to buyer intent.
